description: This PHP source file defines the class AuthProviderChain within the namespace OrangeHRM\Authentication\Auth. The class manages a chain of authentication providers, allowing addition of providers with priority checks and performing authentication by iterating over registered providers.

classes.name: AuthProviderChain
classes.description: Manages a collection of authentication providers, supports adding providers with conflict checks, and performs authentication by iterating over providers based on priority.

methods.name: addProvider
methods.description: Adds an authentication provider to the chain, checks for duplicate class registration, and conflicts in priority.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Attempts to authenticate using the registered providers ordered by priority, returning true if any provider authenticates successfully.
